</head>
<body>
<header>
  <div class="logo">Adaptive Class Seed</div>
  <div class="tag">Interactive â€¢ Local profiles â€¢ Presentation drafts</div>
</header>

<main>
  <!-- left control column -->
  <aside class="panel">
    <h3>Quick Actions</h3>
    <div class="dashboard-grid">
      <div class="big-card">
        <p class="muted">Initialize a new student with the guided 10-question flow.</p>
        <div class="control-row" style="margin-top:8px">
          <button id="start-init" class="btn">Start Initialization</button>
          <button id="quick-init-sample" class="ghost">Sample Profile</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="big-card">
        <p class="muted">Profiles saved locally. Export or import JSON for backup.</p>
        <div style="margin-top:8px" class="control-row">
          <button id="export-json" class="ghost">Export JSON</button>
          <button id="import-json" class="ghost">Import JSON</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="big-card">
        <p class="muted">Audit & tools</p>
        <div class="control-row">
          <button id="generate-audit" class="ghost">Generate 1000-point Audit</button>
          <button id="view-audit" class="ghost">View Audit Summary</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="big-card">
        <p class="muted">Utilities</p>
        <div class="control-row">
          <button id="play-sound" class="ghost">Play Sound</button>
          <button id="celebrate" class="ghost">Celebrate</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </aside>

  <!-- main workspace -->
  <section class="workspace panel">
    <div class="center-col">
      <div>
        <h2 class="title">Dashboard</h2>
        <p class="subtitle">Start the student initialization, manage profiles, or create a quick presentation draft.</p>
      </div>

      <!-- initialization / forms area -->
      <div id="init-area" class="big-card">
        <h3 style="margin-top:0">Initialization</h3>
        <p class="muted">Click <strong>Start Initialization</strong> to begin the 10-question guided flow. You can fill manually or use sample data.</p>

        <!-- dynamic content will appear here -->
        <div id="init-flow"></div>
      </div>

      <!-- profiles -->
      <div class="big-card">
        <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center">
          <h3 style="margin:0">Saved Profiles</h3>
          <div class="mini">Total: <span id="profile-count">0</span></div>
        </div>
        <div class="profiles-list" id="profiles-list"></div>
      </div>

      <!-- tools: presentation and simplifier -->
      <div class="big-card">
        <h3 style="margin-top:0">Presentation Draft & Simplifier</h3>
        <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center">
          <input id="pd-name" placeholder="Student name (saved)" type="text" style="flex:1" />
          <input id="pd-topic" placeholder="Topic (e.g., climate change)" type="text" style="width:260px" />
          <select id="pd-length">
            <option value="short">Short (1-2 min)</option>
            <option value="medium">Medium (3-4 min)</option>
            <option value="long">Long (4-6 min)</option>
          </select>
        </div>
        <div style="margin-top:10px;display:flex;gap:8px">
          <button id="make-draft" class="btn">Generate Draft</button>
          <button id="simplify-text" class="ghost">Simplify Text</button>
        </div>
        <div style="margin-top:10px">
          <textarea id="draft-output" placeholder="Draft / simplified text appears here"></textarea>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>
</main>

<footer>
  Adaptive Class Seed â€¢ Local-only demo â€¢ Save data locally using your browser
</footer>

<!-- modal scaffolding -->
<div id="modal-root" class="modal-backdrop" role="dialog" aria-modal="true">
  <div class="modal-box" id="modal-box">
    <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center">
      <div>
        <div class="modal-title" id="modal-title">Modal</div>
        <div class="modal-body" id="modal-body">...</div>
      </div>
      <div><button id="modal-close" class="ghost">Close</button></div>
    </div>
    <div id="modal-content"></div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- fireworks container -->
<div id="fireworks"></div>

<script>
/* ---------- Seed core (client-side) ---------- */
(function(){
  // ---------- Utilities ----------
  const $ = (id)=>document.getElementById(id);
  const now = ()=>new Date().toISOString();
  const uid = (n=6)=>Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,2+n);

  // ---------- Storage wrapper ----------
  const KeyProfiles = 'acs_profiles_v1';
  const KeyAudit = 'acs_audit_v1';
  function saveProfiles(obj){localStorage.setItem(KeyProfiles, JSON.stringify(obj))}
  function loadProfiles(){try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KeyProfiles) || '{}')}catch(e){return {}}}
  function saveAudit(a){localStorage.setItem(KeyAudit, JSON.stringify(a))}
  function loadAudit(){try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KeyAudit) || 'null')}catch(e){return null}}

  // ---------- State ----------
  let Profiles = loadProfiles(); // {id: profile}
  let Audit = loadAudit(); // array or null

  // ---------- DOM references ----------
  const startBtn = $('start-init');
  const sampleBtn = $('quick-init-sample');
  const initFlow = $('init-flow');
  const profilesList = $('profiles-list');
  const profileCountEl = $('profile-count');
  const exportBtn = $('export-json');
  const importBtn = $('import-json');
  const generateAuditBtn = $('generate-audit');
  const viewAuditBtn = $('view-audit');
  const playSoundBtn = $('play-sound');
  const celebrateBtn = $('celebrate');
  const modalRoot = $('modal-root');
  const modalTitle = $('modal-title');
  const modalBody = $('modal-body');
  const modalContent = $('modal-content');
  const modalClose = $('modal-close');
  const fireworksRoot = $('fireworks');

  const pdName = $('pd-name');
  const pdTopic = $('pd-topic');
  const pdLength = $('pd-length');
  const makeDraftBtn = $('make-draft');
  const simplifyBtn = $('simplify-text');
  const draftOutput = $('draft-output');

  // ---------- Sound helpers (simple WebAudio) ----------
  const audioCtx = (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext) ? new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)() : null;
  function beep(freq=440,dur=0.12,vol=0.15){
    if(!audioCtx) return;
    const o = audioCtx.createOscillator();
    const g = audioCtx.createGain();
    o.connect(g); g.connect(audioCtx.destination);
    o.frequency.value = freq; o.type = 'sine';
    g.gain.value = vol;
    o.start(); o.stop(audioCtx.currentTime+dur);
  }
  function chord(notes, dur=0.35){
    if(!audioCtx) return;
    notes.forEach(n=>{ const o=audioCtx.createOscillator(); const g=audioCtx.createGain();
      o.connect(g); g.connect(audioCtx.destination); o.frequency.value=n; o.type='sine'; g.gain.value=0.08;
      o.start(); o.stop(audioCtx.currentTime+dur);
    });
  }

  // ---------- UI: modal ----------
  function showModal(title, bodyHTML, contentNode){
    modalTitle.textContent = title||'Modal';
    modalBody.textContent = '';
    modalBody.innerHTML = bodyHTML||'';
    modalContent.innerHTML = '';
    if(contentNode) modalContent.appendChild(contentNode);
    modalRoot.classList.add('show');
  }
  function hideModal(){ modalRoot.classList.remove('show'); modalContent.innerHTML=''; }

  modalClose.addEventListener('click', hideModal);
  modalRoot.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{ if(e.target===modalRoot) hideModal(); });

  // ---------- Profile utilities ----------
  function normalizeNumericVal(v){
    const n = Number(String(v).trim());
    return Number.isFinite(n) ? Math.max(0, Math.min(10, Math.round(n*10)/10)) : null;
  }

  function computeLevel(profile){
    const keys = ['listening','speaking','pronunciation'];
    const vals = keys.map(k=>profile.computed[k]).filter(v=>typeof v==='number');
    if(!vals.length) return 'Unassessed';
    const avg = vals.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/vals.length;
    if(avg>=8) return 'Advanced';
    if(avg>=6) return 'Upper-Intermediate';
    if(avg>=4) return 'Intermediate';
    return 'Beginner';
  }

  // ---------- Rendering profiles list ----------
  function renderProfiles(){
    profilesList.innerHTML = '';
    const keys = Object.keys(Profiles).sort();
    profileCountEl.textContent = keys.length;
    if(keys.length===0){
      const p = document.createElement('div'); p.className='mini muted'; p.textContent = 'No profiles yet.';
      profilesList.appendChild(p); return;
    }
    keys.forEach(k=>{
      const p = Profiles[k];
      const card = document.createElement('div'); card.className='profile-card';
      const left = document.createElement('div');
      left.innerHTML = `<div style="font-weight:800;color:var(--accent)">${p.raw.name||p.id}</div><div class="mini">${p.raw.nativeLanguage||'N/A'} â€¢ ${p.computed.level||computeLevel(p)}</div>`;
      const right = document.createElement('div');
      const btnView = document.createElement('button'); btnView.className='ghost'; btnView.textContent='View';
      btnView.addEventListener('click', ()=>openProfileModal(p.id));
      const btnDelete = document.createElement('button'); btnDelete.className='ghost'; btnDelete.textContent='Delete';
      btnDelete.style.marginLeft='8px';
      btnDelete.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
        if(!confirm('Delete profile "'+p.id+'"?')) return;
        delete Profiles[p.id]; saveProfiles(Profiles); renderProfiles();
      });
      right.appendChild(btnView); right.appendChild(btnDelete);
      card.appendChild(left); card.appendChild(right);
      profilesList.appendChild(card);
    });
  }

  // ---------- Modal to show profile & quick tools ----------
  function openProfileModal(id){
    const p = Profiles[id];
    if(!p) return alert('Profile not found');
    const container = document.createElement('div');
    container.style.display='grid';
    container.style.gridTemplateColumns='1fr 1fr';
    container.style.gap='10px';

    const info = document.createElement('div');
    info.innerHTML = `<strong>${p.raw.name || p.id}</strong><div class="mini" style="margin-top:6px">Created: ${p.createdAt}</div>
      <div style="margin-top:8px"><div class="small">Level: <span class="tone">${p.computed.level || computeLevel(p)}</span></div>
      <div class="small">Listening: ${p.computed.listening ?? 'N/A'}</div>
      <div class="small">Speaking: ${p.computed.speaking ?? 'N/A'}</div>
      <div class="small">Pronunciation: ${p.computed.pronunciation ?? 'N/A'}</div>
      </div>`;
    container.appendChild(info);

    const tools = document.createElement('div');
    tools.innerHTML = `<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap">
        <button id="btn-assess" class="ghost">Quick Assessment Prompts</button>
        <button id="btn-draft" class="ghost">Make Presentation Draft</button>
        <button id="btn-export-profile" class="ghost">Export Profile JSON</button>
      </div>`;
    container.appendChild(tools);

    showModal('Profile â€” ' + p.id, '', container);

    // handlers
    $('btn-assess').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      const el = document.createElement('div');
      el.innerHTML = `<p class="small">Ask the student to:</p>
        <ol style="color:var(--muted)">
          <li>Read a 30s paragraph aloud â€” rate clarity (0-10)</li>
          <li>Describe a picture in 5 sentences â€” rate fluency (0-10)</li>
          <li>Listen to 30s clip & summarize â€” rate listening (0-10)</li>
          <li>Pronunciation check featuring 'th' and final consonants â€” rate (0-10)</li>
          <li>Structure: give intro/body/conclusion â€” rate (0-10)</li>
        </ol>
        <p class="small">Use the recordScores function in the console or the UI to store numbers.</p>`;
      showModal('Assessment Prompts', '', el);
    });

    $('btn-draft').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      hideModal();
      pdName.value = p.id;
      pdTopic.focus();
      alert('Student set for draft generation. Enter a topic and click Generate Draft.');
    });

    $('btn-export-profile').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      const text = JSON.stringify(p, null, 2);
      const area = document.createElement('textarea'); area.style.width='100%'; area.style.height='220px'; area.textContent=text;
      showModal('Export Profile JSON', 'Copy the JSON below for backup or transfer.', area);
    });
  }

  // ---------- Initialization (10 questions) ----------
  const questions = [
    {key:'name', prompt:'Student name'},
    {key:'age', prompt:'Age'},
    {key:'nativeLanguage', prompt:'Native language (e.g., Vietnamese)'},
    {key:'currentListening', prompt:'Listening skill (0-10)'},
    {key:'currentSpeaking', prompt:'Speaking skill (0-10)'},
    {key:'currentPronunciation', prompt:'Pronunciation skill (0-10)'},
    {key:'presentationExperience', prompt:'Presentation experience (None/Some/Experienced)'},
    {key:'goals', prompt:'Top 3 learning goals (comma separated)'},
    {key:'availability', prompt:'Preferred practice time/frequency'},
    {key:'notes', prompt:'Any special considerations (e.g., anxiety)'}
  ];

  function buildInitUI(prefill){
    initFlow.innerHTML = '';
    const box = document.createElement('div'); box.style.display='grid'; box.style.gap='10px';
    const form = document.createElement('form'); form.className='field-grid';
    questions.forEach((q,idx)=>{
      const wrap = document.createElement('div');
      const lab = document.createElement('label'); lab.textContent = q.prompt;
      const input = document.createElement('input'); input.type = (q.key.indexOf('current')>=0)?'number':'text';
      input.id = 'q-'+q.key; input.placeholder = q.prompt;
      if(prefill && prefill[q.key]!=null) input.value = prefill[q.key];
      wrap.appendChild(lab); wrap.appendChild(input);
      if(idx===8) wrap.className='wide';
      form.appendChild(wrap);
    });
    const submitRow = document.createElement('div'); submitRow.style.display='flex'; submitRow.style.gap='8px';
    const submit = document.createElement('button'); submit.type='button'; submit.className='btn'; submit.textContent='Save Profile';
    const cancel = document.createElement('button'); cancel.type='button'; cancel.className='ghost'; cancel.textContent='Cancel';
    submitRow.appendChild(submit); submitRow.appendChild(cancel);
    box.appendChild(form); box.appendChild(submitRow);
    initFlow.appendChild(box);

    cancel.addEventListener('click', ()=>{ initFlow.innerHTML=''; });

    submit.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      const responses = {};
      let ok = true;
      questions.forEach(q=>{
        const v = $('q-'+q.key).value || '';
        responses[q.key] = v;
        if(q.key==='name' && (!v || v.trim()==='')) ok=false;
      });
      if(!ok) return alert('Please enter at least a name.');
      const id = responses.name.trim();
      const profile = {
        id,
        createdAt: now(),
        raw: responses,
        computed: {}
      };
      profile.computed.listening = normalizeNumericVal(responses.currentListening);
      profile.computed.speaking = normalizeNumericVal(responses.currentSpeaking);
      profile.computed.pronunciation = normalizeNumericVal(responses.currentPronunciation);
      profile.computed.goals = (responses.goals||'').split(',').map(s=>s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
      profile.computed.presentationExperience = responses.presentationExperience || 'Unknown';
      profile.computed.availability = responses.availability || '';
      profile.raw.notes = responses.notes || '';
      profile.computed.level = computeLevel(profile);
      Profiles[id] = profile; saveProfiles(Profiles); renderProfiles();
      initFlow.innerHTML = '<div class="small">Profile saved: <strong>'+id+'</strong></div>';
      beep(880,0.09);
    });
  }

  // ---------- Sample quick profile ----------
  sampleBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    const sample = {
      name: 'Sample Student',
      age: '13',
      nativeLanguage: 'Vietnamese',
      currentListening: '7',
      currentSpeaking: '6',
      currentPronunciation: '5',
      presentationExperience: 'Some',
      goals: 'fluency,confidence,pronunciation',
      availability: 'Weekends',
      notes: 'N/A'
    };
    buildInitUI(sample);
  });

  // ---------- Start initialization ----------
  startBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{ buildInitUI(); });

  // ---------- export/import ----------
  exportBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    const txt = JSON.stringify(Profiles, null, 2);
    const area = document.createElement('textarea'); area.style.width='100%'; area.style.height='300px'; area.textContent=txt;
    showModal('Export Profiles JSON', 'Copy the JSON below to backup profiles.', area);
  });

  importBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    const area = document.createElement('textarea'); area.style.width='100%'; area.style.height='220px';
    area.placeholder = 'Paste JSON here and click Import';
    const btn = document.createElement('button'); btn.className='btn'; btn.textContent='Import';
    const wrap = document.createElement('div'); wrap.style.display='flex'; wrap.style.flexDirection='column'; wrap.style.gap='8px';
    wrap.appendChild(area); wrap.appendChild(btn);
    showModal('Import Profiles JSON', 'Paste exported profiles JSON (overwrites any existing profile with same id).', wrap);
    btn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      try{
        const parsed = JSON.parse(area.value);
        if(typeof parsed !== 'object') throw new Error('Invalid JSON');
        Object.keys(parsed).forEach(k=>Profiles[k]=parsed[k]);
        saveProfiles(Profiles); renderProfiles(); hideModal(); alert('Import complete.');
      }catch(e){ alert('Import failed: '+e.message) }
    });
  });

  // ---------- Audit generator (1000 items) ----------
  function generateThousandAudit(){
    const categories = ["UX","Accessibility","Pedagogy","Content","Pronunciation","Performance","Security","Data","Compatibility","Testing"];
    const audit = [];
    for(let i=1;i<=1000;i++){
      const cat = categories[i % categories.length];
      const id = 'AUD-'+String(i).padStart(4,'0');
      const t=i%7;
      const desc = t===0 ? `Check ${cat}: responsiveness on low-end devices.` :
                   t===1 ? `Check ${cat}: keyboard and screen-reader accessibility.` :
                   t===2 ? `Check ${cat}: sentence simplicity for ESL learners.` :
                   t===3 ? `Check ${cat}: audio/TTS fallback available.` :
                   t===4 ? `Check ${cat}: pronunciation tips for difficult words.` :
                   t===5 ? `Check ${cat}: storage/restore of student progress.` :
                           `Check ${cat}: unit & integration test coverage.`;
      audit.push({id, category:cat, description:desc, status:'pending'});
    }
    return audit;
  }

  generateAuditBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    if(confirm('Generate the 1000-point audit? This will create and save a large list in localStorage.')) {
      Audit = generateThousandAudit(); saveAudit(Audit); alert('Audit generated (1000 items). Use "View Audit Summary" to inspect.');
    }
  });

  viewAuditBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    Audit = loadAudit();
    if(!Audit) return alert('No audit found. Generate it first.');
    // show brief summary: counts by category & top 10 items
    const counts = {};
    Audit.forEach(a=>counts[a.category]=(counts[a.category]||0)+1);
    const node = document.createElement('div');
    const list = document.createElement('div');
    list.innerHTML = '<div class="small" style="margin-bottom:8px">Counts by category:</div>';
    Object.keys(counts).forEach(c=>{ const r=document.createElement('div'); r.className='small'; r.textContent = `${c}: ${counts[c]}`; list.appendChild(r); });
    const top10 = Audit.slice(0,10).map(x=>`â€¢ ${x.id}: ${x.description}`).join('\n');
    const pre = document.createElement('pre'); pre.style.whiteSpace='pre-wrap'; pre.style.color='var(--muted)'; pre.textContent = top10;
    node.appendChild(list); node.appendChild(pre);
    showModal('Audit Summary', 'Top 10 audit items (first 10) and category counts', node);
  });

  // ---------- Presentation draft generator (simple, level-aware) ----------
  function simplifyForVietnameseESL(text){
    if(!text) return text;
    const rules = [
      [/\\butilize\\b/gi,'use'],
      [/\\bcommence\\b/gi,'start'],
      [/\\bconsequently\\b/gi,'so'],
      [/\\bmoreover\\b/gi,'also'],
      [/\\bapproximately\\b/gi,'about'],
      [/\\bpronunciation\\b/gi,'pronounce / pronunciation (practice tip)'],
      [/\\s{2,}/g,' ']
    ];
    let out = text;
    rules.forEach(([find,rep])=> out = out.replace(find, rep));
    return out.trim();
  }

  function generatePresentationDraft(name, topic, length='short', simplify=true){
    const p = Profiles[name] || null;
    const level = p ? (p.computed.level || computeLevel(p)) : 'Intermediate';
    let intro = level==='Advanced' ? `Good morning. Today I will examine ${topic}, focusing on implications and examples.` :
                level==='Upper-Intermediate' ? `Hello. I will speak about ${topic} and explain the main points.` :
                `Hello. My topic is ${topic}. I will explain the main idea and finish quickly.`;
    let body;
    if(length==='short'){
      body = [
        `Point 1: A clear explanation or simple example.`,
        `Point 2: A reason or supporting fact.`,
        `Point 3: A conclusion or suggestion.`
      ];
    } else if(length==='medium'){
      body = [
        `Point 1: Explanation and one example.`,
        `Point 2: Reason with a short statistic or fact.`,
        `Point 3: An opposite view or limitation.`,
        `Point 4: A short recommendation.`
      ];
    } else {
      body = [
        `Point 1: Detailed explanation with example.`,
        `Point 2: Data or quote supporting the idea.`,
        `Point 3: Counterpoint and response.`,
        `Point 4: Practical suggestion and next steps.`
      ];
    }
    let conclusion = level==='Advanced' ? `In conclusion, these points summarize the significance of ${topic}. Thank you.` : `To finish, these are the main ideas about ${topic}. Thank you.`;
    if(simplify){
      intro = simplifyForVietnameseESL(intro);
      body = body.map(simplifyForVietnameseESL);
      conclusion = simplifyForVietnameseESL(conclusion);
    }
    const out = {title: topic, intro, body, conclusion, createdAt: now(), level};
    // record in profile history
    if(p){
      p.history = p.history || [];
      p.history.push({type:'presentation', draft:out, createdAt: now()});
      Profiles[p.id] = p; saveProfiles(Profiles);
    }
    return out;
  }

  makeDraftBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    const nm = pdName.value.trim();
    if(!nm){ return alert('Enter student name (must be saved to profile to attach).'); }
    const topic = pdTopic.value.trim() || 'A topic';
    const draft = generatePresentationDraft(nm, topic, pdLength.value, true);
    draftOutput.value = `Title: ${draft.title}\n\nIntro:\n${draft.intro}\n\nBody:\n${draft.body.join('\n')}\n\nConclusion:\n${draft.conclusion}`;
    beep(880,0.06);
  });

  // Simplify arbitrary text (from draftOutput)
  simplifyBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    const input = draftOutput.value.trim();
    if(!input) return alert('No text to simplify.');
    draftOutput.value = simplifyForVietnameseESL(input);
    beep(1200,0.08);
  });

  // ---------- Sound & celebrate ----------
  playSoundBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>beep(660,0.12));
  celebrateBtn.addEventListener('click', launchFireworks);

  // fireworks implementation (simple DOM particles)
  function launchFireworks(times=1){
    if(!fireworksRoot) return;
    for(let t=0;t<times;t++){
      setTimeout(()=>{ for(let i=0;i<18;i++){
        const el = document.createElement('div'); el.className='fw';
        const size = Math.random()*12+6; el.style.width = el.style.height = size+'px';
        const left = Math.random()*100; const top = Math.random()*60+10;
        el.style.left = left+'%'; el.style.top = top+'%';
        const hue = Math.random()*60 + 250; el.style.background = `hsl(${hue}deg 90% 60%)`;
        el.style.opacity = 0.95; el.style.transform = `translate3d(0,0,0)`;
        el.style.boxShadow = `0 0 12px ${el.style.background}`;
        fireworksRoot.appendChild(el);
        // animate
        const dx = (Math.random()-0.5)*200; const dy = -Math.random()*400-60; const dur = 800 + Math.random()*600;
        el.animate([{transform:'translate(0,0)', opacity:1},{transform:`translate(${dx}px,${dy}px)`, opacity:0}],{duration:dur,easing:'cubic-bezier(.2,.6,.2,1)'});
        setTimeout(()=>el.remove(), 1200);
      }}, t*220);
    }
    chord([440,660,880],0.28);
  }

  // ---------- Play a short "startup" beep on load (user gesture may be required) ----------
  window.addEventListener('click', function once(){ beep(440,0.05); window.removeEventListener('click', once); }, {once:true});

  // ---------- initial render ----------
  renderProfiles();

  // ---------- simple keyboard helper: open init with "I" ----------
  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e)=>{ if(e.key==='i' || e.key==='I'){ buildInitUI(); window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'}) } });

  // ---------- expose some helper functions to console (for power users) ----------
  window.ACS = {
    Profiles,
    saveProfiles: ()=>saveProfiles(Profiles),
    loadProfiles: ()=>{Profiles=loadProfiles(); renderProfiles(); return Profiles},
    generateAudit: ()=>{ Audit = generateThousandAudit(); saveAudit(Audit); return Audit },
    getAuditSummary: ()=>{ const a = loadAudit(); if(!a) return null; const counts={}; a.forEach(x=>counts[x.category]=(counts[x.category]||0)+1); return {total:a.length, counts, first10:a.slice(0,10)} },
    generateDraft: generatePresentationDraft,
    simplifyText: simplifyForVietnameseESL
  };

  // Small UX: open a simple welcome modal on first load
  if(!localStorage.getItem('acs_seen_welcome')){
    const n = document.createElement('div'); n.innerHTML = '<p class="small">Welcome â€” this demo runs fully in your browser. Data is stored locally. Click "Start Initialization" to create a student profile.</p>';
    showModal('Welcome', '', n); localStorage.setItem('acs_seen_welcome','1');
  }

})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>

    <style>
        :root {

            --body-font: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
        }

        body {
            font-family: var(--body-font);
            background-color: var(--bg-color);
            color: var(--text-color);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 2rem;
            min-height: 100vh;
        }

        /* --- Main Title --- */
        .main-title {
            font-family: var(--title-font);
            font-size: 4rem;
            color: var(--accent-color);
            letter-spacing: 3px;
            text-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--accent-color), 0 0 20px var(--accent-color), 0 0 30px #000;
            animation: flicker 2s infinite alternate;
            margin: 0;
            text-align: center;
        }
        
        .sub-title {
            font-size: 1.25rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--border-color);
            text-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--border-color);
            margin-bottom: 2rem;
        }

        /* --- Team Card Grid --- */
        .team-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            gap: 1.5rem;
            width: 100%;
            max-width: 1200px;
            margin-bottom: 2rem;
        }

        /* Desktop: 2x2 grid */
        @media (min-width: 768px) {
            .team-grid {
                grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            }
        }
        
        /* Desktop: 4-column grid */
        @media (min-width: 1200px) {
            .team-grid {
                grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
            }
        }

        .team-card {
            background: linear-gradient(145deg, var(--panel-color), #0f0f2a);
            border: 3px solid var(--border-color);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: 1.5rem;
            text-align: center;
            box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(255, 0, 255, 0.3), inset 0 0 15px rgba(20, 20, 50, 0.5);
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .team-card h2 {
            font-family: var(--title-font);
            font-size: 2.5rem;
            margin: 0 0 1rem 0;
            color: var(--border-color);
            letter-spacing: 2px;
        }

        .student-display {
            background-color: #000;
            border: 2px solid var(--accent-color);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: 2rem 1rem;
            min-height: 100px; /* Ensure all cards are same height */
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            box-shadow: inset 0 0 15px rgba(0, 255, 255, 0.3);
        }

        .result-name {
            font-size: 2rem;
            font-weight: 900;
            color: #fff;
            text-shadow: 0 0 10px #fff;
            transition: all 0.2s ease;
            /* For the scramble text */
            word-break: break-all;
            hyphens: auto;
        }

        /* --- Animation Class --- */
        .result-name.is-selecting {
            font-size: 2.2rem;
            animation: scramble-flicker 0.05s infinite;
        }
        
        @keyframes scramble-flicker {
            0% {
                color: var(--accent-color);
                text-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--accent-color);
            }
            50% {
                color: var(--border-color);
                text-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--border-color);
            }
            100% {
                color: #fff;
            }
        }


        /* --- Master Button --- */
        #select-btn {
            font-family: var(--title-font);
            font-size: 3rem;
            letter-spacing: 3px;
            color: var(--bg-color);
            background-color: var(--accent-color);
            border: none;
            padding: 1rem 3rem;
            border-radius: 10px;
            cursor: pointer;
            box-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--accent-color), 0 0 30px var(--accent-color);
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }
        
        #select-btn:hover {
            background-color: #fff;
            color: var(--border-color);
            box-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--border-color), 0 0 30px var(--border-color), 0 0 50px var(--border-color);
            transform: scale(1.05);
        }

        #select-btn:active {
            transform: scale(0.95);
        }

        #select-btn:disabled {
            background-color: #333;
            color: #666;
            box-shadow: none;
            cursor: not-allowed;
            animation: none;
        }
        
        @keyframes flicker {
            0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
            50% { opacity: 0.8; }
        }

    </style>
</head>

            team3: [

            ],
            team4: [
                "Báº¢O NAM", "QUANG NHáº¬T", "THÃNH Äáº T", "THANH MINH", "MINH KHAI", "MINH KHANG",
                "Yáº¾N MINH", "HUá»²NH AN", "MINH TUáº¤N", "TIáº¾N THÃ€NH", "ANH THÆ¯", "PHÃšC Háº¬U"
            ]
        };

        // --- 2. DOM ELEMENTS ---
        const selectBtn = document.getElementById('select-btn');
        const displays = {
            team1: document.getElementById('result-team1'),
            team2: document.getElementById('result-team2'),
            team3: document.getElementById('result-team3'),
            team4: document.getElementById('result-team4')
        };
        const allDisplayElements = Object.values(displays);
        
        // Characters to use in the scramble animation
        const scrambleChars = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZÄ1234567890@#$?!";
        let scrambleIntervals = [];

        // --- 3. FUNCTIONS ---

        /**
         * Picks a random student from a given team array.
         */
        function getRandomStudent(teamArray) {
            return teamArray[Math.floor(Math.random() * teamArray.length)];
        }

        /**
         * Starts the scramble animation on a specific display.
         */
        function startScramble(displayElement) {
            // Set the element to scramble mode
            displayElement.classList.add('is-selecting');
            
            // Start an interval to rapidly change the text
            const intervalId = setInterval(() => {
                let randomText = "";
                // Generate random text (length 3 to 10)
                const textLength = Math.floor(Math.random() * 7) + 3;
                for (let i = 0; i < textLength; i++) {
                    randomText += scrambleChars[Math.floor(Math.random() * scrambleChars.length)];
                }
                displayElement.textContent = randomText;
            }, 50); // Change text every 50ms

            // Store the interval ID so we can stop it later
            scrambleIntervals.push(intervalId);
        }

        /**
         * Stops the scramble animation and shows the final name.
         */
        function stopScramble(displayElement, name) {
            // Clear any running interval for this element
            scrambleIntervals.forEach(clearInterval);
            scrambleIntervals = []; // Clear the array
            
            displayElement.classList.remove('is-selecting');
            displayElement.textContent = name;
        }

        /**
         * Main function to run the selection process.
         */
        function selectStudents() {
            // Disable button to prevent spam clicking
            selectBtn.disabled = true;
            selectBtn.textContent = "SELECTING...";

            // 1. Get all the winners first
            const winners = {
                team1: getRandomStudent(teams.team1),
                team2: getRandomStudent(teams.team2),
                team3: getRandomStudent(teams.team3),
                team4: getRandomStudent(teams.team4)
            };

            // 2. Start scrambling all displays
            allDisplayElements.forEach(el => startScramble(el));

            // 3. Reveal winners one by one (staggered reveal)
            setTimeout(() => {
                stopScramble(displays.team1, winners.team1);
            }, 1500); // Reveal Team 1 after 1.5s

            setTimeout(() => {
                stopScramble(displays.team2, winners.team2);
            }, 2000); // Reveal Team 2 after 2s

            setTimeout(() => {
                stopScramble(displays.team3, winners.team3);
            }, 2500); // Reveal Team 3 after 2.5s

            setTimeout(() => {
                stopScramble(displays.team4, winners.team4);
                
                // Re-enable the button after the final reveal
                selectBtn.disabled = false;
                selectBtn.textContent = "SELECT AGAIN";
            }, 3000); // Reveal Team 4 after 3s
        }

        // --- 4. EVENT LISTENER ---
        selectBtn.addEventListener('click', selectStudents);

    </script>

                { "name": "Key Concepts", "icon": "ðŸŽ¯", "content": [{"term": "Primary Theme", "def": `Exploration of ${lesson.title}'s core idea.`}, {"term": "Secondary Theme", "def": "A related concept for deeper understanding."}] },
                { "name": "Deeper Analysis", "icon": "ðŸ§ ", "content": `This section provides a deep, nuanced analysis of "${lesson.title}", exploring its mythological roots, literary significance, and impact on popular culture.` },
                { "name": "Hypothetical Scenario", "icon": "âš™ï¸", "content": `Imagine a world where the central conflict of "${lesson.title}" was resolved differently. What would the long-term consequences be for Superman and humanity?` },
                { "name": "Critical Thinking", "icon": "ðŸ¤”", "content": [`What does this story teach us about our own world?`, `Is the lesson of "${lesson.title}" still relevant today? Why or why not?`] }
            ];
            const introduction = `An immersive exploration into the archetype of "${lesson.title}", designed to provide a comprehensive understanding of its role in the Superman mythos.`;
            const takeaway = `The central, unforgettable truth of "${lesson.title}" is that great power forces even greater choices.`;

            let tabsHtml = tabs.map((tab, index) => `<button class="lesson-nav-button ${index === 0 ? 'active' : ''}" data-target="tab-${lessonId}-${index}">${tab.icon} ${tab.name}</button>`).join('');
            let tabContentHtml = tabs.map((tab, index) => {
                 let contentHtml = '';
                if (Array.isArray(tab.content)) {
                    if (tab.name === "Key Concepts") {
                        contentHtml = tab.content.map(c => `<li class="mb-3"><strong class="text-gold-light">${c.term}:</strong> <span class="text-text-muted">${c.def}</span></li>`).join('');
                        contentHtml = `<ul class="list-none pl-0 space-y-2">${contentHtml}</ul>`;
                    } else { // Critical Thinking
                        contentHtml = tab.content.map(q => `<li class="mb-2">${q}</li>`).join('');
                        contentHtml = `<ul class="list-disc pl-5 space-y-2 text-text-muted">${contentHtml}</ul>`;
                    }
                } else {
                    contentHtml = `<p class="text-text-muted leading-relaxed">${tab.content}</p>`;
                }
                return `<div id="tab-${lessonId}-${index}" class="lesson-tab-content ${index === 0 ? '' : 'hidden'} mt-6">${contentHtml}</div>`;
            }).join('');

            return `
                <div class="p-4 md:p-8">
                    <header class="text-center pb-8">
                        <div class="flex justify-center items-center gap-4">
                           ${cosmicGlyphs[lesson.pillar] ? cosmicGlyphs[lesson.pillar].replace('cosmic-glyph', 'w-10 h-10 text-purple-light opacity-50') : ''}
                           <h1 class="text-3xl font-bold text-primary-gold title-pop">Lesson ${lesson.lesson}: ${lesson.title}</h1>
                        </div>
                        <p class="text-lg mt-2 text-text-muted">${introduction}</p>
                    </header>
                    <nav class="sticky top-0 z-10 p-2 flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-2 mb-6 bg-bg-dark rounded-lg">${tabsHtml}</nav>
                    <div class="lesson-tab-container">${tabContentHtml}</div>
                    <div class="mt-8 pt-4 border-t border-primary-purple">
                        <p class="font-bold text-lg text-primary-gold title-pop">ðŸ’¡ Key Takeaway:</p>
                        <p class="text-text-muted italic">${takeaway}</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;
        }
        
        function expandLesson(lessonId) {
            const allCards = document.querySelectorAll('.lesson-card');
            const targetCard = document.getElementById(`lesson-card-${lessonId}`);
            if (targetCard.classList.contains('expanded')) return;
            
            targetCard.querySelector('.full-lesson-content').innerHTML = generateFullLessonContent(lessonId);
            
            backdrop.classList.remove('opacity-0', 'pointer-events-none');
            allCards.forEach(card => {
                if (card.id !== targetCard.id) card.classList.add('minimized');
            });
            targetCard.classList.add('expanded');

            targetCard.querySelectorAll('.lesson-nav-button').forEach(button => {
                button.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    const targetId = e.currentTarget.dataset.target;
                    targetCard.querySelectorAll('.lesson-tab-content').forEach(el => el.classList.add('hidden'));
                    targetCard.querySelectorAll('.lesson-nav-button').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
                    document.getElementById(targetId).classList.remove('hidden');
                    e.currentTarget.classList.add('active');
                });
            });
        }
        
        function collapseAllLessons() {
            const expandedCard = document.querySelector('.lesson-card.expanded');
            if (!expandedCard) return;
            
            backdrop.classList.add('opacity-0', 'pointer-events-none');
            expandedCard.classList.remove('expanded');
            setTimeout(() => {
                expandedCard.querySelector('.full-lesson-content').innerHTML = '';
            }, 500);
            
            document.querySelectorAll('.lesson-card.minimized').forEach(card => {
                card.classList.remove('minimized');
            });
        }
        
        renderOverviewCards();
        lessonGrid.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            const card = e.target.closest('.lesson-card');
            if (card && !card.classList.contains('expanded')) expandLesson(card.dataset.lessonId);
        });
        backdrop.addEventListener('click', collapseAllLessons);
    });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

        @keyframes fadeIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }

</head>

    <script type="application/json" id="geopolitics-data-json">

        {

            "introduction": "Maps are not neutral objects; they are arguments. This lesson reveals how maps are used as political tools to claim territory, project power, and shape our perception of the world and its borders.",

        {

            "introduction": "Why do nations form alliances? This lesson explores the timeless concept of the Balance of Power, a core principle where states form coalitions to prevent any single state from becoming too dominant and threatening the others.",

        {

            "introduction": "We dive into one of the most influential (and controversial) theories ever: Halford Mackinder's idea that control of the Eurasian 'Heartland' is the key to world domination. Its echoes can still be heard in global strategy today.",
            "concepts": [

            ],
            "takeaway": "â€œWho rules East Europe commands the Heartland; who rules the Heartland commands the World-Island; who rules the World-Island commands the world.â€"

        {

            "takeaway": "Spykman's famous counter to Mackinder: â€œWho controls the Rimland rules Eurasia; who rules Eurasia controls the destinies of the world.â€"

        {

            "introduction": "Are states doomed to a perpetual struggle for power, or can cooperation and international institutions lead to peace? This lesson examines the two dominant, and often competing, schools of thought in international relations: Realism and Liberalism.",

        {

            "introduction": "Who feeds the world? The ability to produce and export staple crops like wheat and corn is a subtle but immense source of power. We explore how food exports can be used to exert influence and why food security is a top priority for all nations.",
            "concepts": [

            "questions_to_consider": [

        {
            "lesson": 12, "pillar": "Resources & Conflict", "title": "Proxy Wars & Frozen Conflicts",
            "introduction": "Great powers often avoid direct confrontation by fighting through others. This lesson examines the nature of proxy wars, where rivals support opposing sides in a regional conflict, and 'frozen conflicts' that are left unresolved as points of leverage.",
            "concepts": [
                {"term": "Proxy War", "def": "A conflict instigated by opposing powers who do not fight each other directly, but use third parties to do the fighting."},
                {"term": "Non-State Actor", "def": "An individual or organization with significant political influence that is not allied to any particular country or state."},

            "takeaway": "Proxy wars allow major powers to compete for influence without risking a direct, and potentially catastrophic, war."

            "takeaway": "The battle for the 21st century is being fought not just on land and sea, but on the servers and fiber optic cables of the digital world."

            "introduction": "The cosmos is the ultimate high ground. We will examine the new space race, which is no longer just between two superpowers but involves multiple nations and private companies vying for strategic and economic advantages in Earth's orbit and beyond.",
            "concepts": [

                {"term": "Satellite Constellation", "def": "A group of artificial satellites working together as a system, often providing global services like GPS or internet."},
                {"term": "Orbital Debris", "def": "The collection of man-made objects in orbit around Earth that are no longer functional, posing a risk to satellites."}

            "lesson": 15, "pillar": "Modern Arenas", "title": "Geoeconomics: Trade & Sanctions",

            "concepts": [
                {"term": "Geoeconomics", "def": "The study of the spatial, temporal, and political aspects of economies and resources."},
                {"term": "Sanctions", "def": "Economic penalties, such as trade barriers or financial restrictions, applied by one or more countries against a targeted state."},
                {"term": "Trade Bloc", "def": "A type of intergovernmental agreement where regional barriers to trade are reduced or eliminated among the participating states."}
            ],
            "questions_to_consider": [
                "Do broad economic sanctions hurt the people of a country more than its leaders?",
                "Is the weaponization of the US dollar's role in global finance a sustainable strategy?",
                "Are we heading towards a world of competing trade blocs rather than a single globalized economy?"
            ],
            "takeaway": "Controlling access to markets and financial systems can be a more effective way to change a state's behavior than military intervention."
        },
        {
            "lesson": 16, "pillar": "Modern Arenas", "title": "Demographics is Destiny",
            "introduction": "A nation's age profile â€“ whether it is young and growing or old and shrinking â€“ has profound implications for its economic power and military potential. We will analyze how demographic trends are reshaping the global balance of power.",
            "concepts": [
                {"term": "Demographics", "def": "Statistical data relating to the population and particular groups within it."},
                {"term": "Youth Bulge", "def": "A common phenomenon in developing countries where a large share of the population is comprised of children and young adults."},
                {"term": "Aging Population", "def": "A trend where the median age of a country rises due to declining birth rates and rising life expectancy, posing economic challenges."}
            ],
            "questions_to_consider": [
                "Can a country with a shrinking population remain a great power?",
                "Is a youth bulge a demographic dividend (more workers) or a demographic time bomb (more instability)?",
                "How will mass migration driven by climate change and economic inequality reshape the demographic map of the world?"
            ],
            "takeaway": "The country with the most favorable demographics for economic growth and innovation often has a long-term strategic advantage."
        },
        {
            "lesson": 17, "pillar": "Future & Synthesis", "title": "The Geopolitics of Climate Change",
            "introduction": "A warming planet will redraw maps and create new sources of conflict and cooperation. This lesson explores the geopolitical implications of climate change, from melting Arctic sea routes to resource competition and climate refugees.",
            "concepts": [
                {"term": "Climate Refugee", "def": "A person who has been forced to leave their home as a result of the effects of climate change on their environment."},
                {"term": "Arctic Passage", "def": "Newly navigable sea routes in the Arctic Ocean that are opening up as a result of melting sea ice, creating new trade lanes and territorial disputes."},
                {"term": "Decarbonization", "def": "The process of reducing carbon dioxide emissions, a central challenge in international climate negotiations."}
            ],
            "questions_to_consider": [
                "Who owns the newly accessible resources under the melting Arctic ice?",
                "Will wealthy nations that industrialized early bear the cost for climate adaptation in developing nations?",
                "Could geoengineering (large-scale climate intervention) become a source of international conflict?"
            ],
            "takeaway": "Climate change is a 'threat multiplier' that will exacerbate existing tensions over resources, borders, and migration."
        },
        {
            "lesson": 18, "pillar": "Future & Synthesis", "title": "The Rise of the Multipolar World",
            "introduction": "The era of a single superpower is fading. We are entering a multipolar world order with several major powers (like the US, China, Russia, and India) competing and cooperating. This lesson analyzes the instability and opportunities of this new system.",
            "concepts": [
                {"term": "Unipolarity", "def": "A distribution of power in which one state exercises most of the cultural, economic, and military influence."},
                {"term": "Bipolarity", "def": "A distribution of power in which two states have the majority of influence, as in the Cold War."},
                {"term": "Multipolarity", "def": "A distribution of power in which more than two nation-states have nearly equal amounts of military, cultural, and economic influence."}
            ],
            "questions_to_consider": [
                "Is a multipolar world inherently more chaotic and dangerous than a unipolar or bipolar one?",
                "Can middle powers thrive by playing the great powers off against each other?",
                "What new international institutions might be needed to manage a multipolar world?"
            ],
            "takeaway": "A multipolar world is more complex and less predictable, with shifting alliances and a constant renegotiation of global rules."
        },
        {
            "lesson": 19, "pillar": "Future & Synthesis", "title": "The Future of the Nation-State",
            "introduction": "Is the state becoming obsolete? This lesson examines the forces challenging the authority of the nation-state, from powerful multinational corporations and supranational bodies like the EU to global networks of non-state actors.",
            "concepts": [
                {"term": "Supranationalism", "def": "A type of multinational political union where negotiated power is delegated to an authority by governments of member states (e.g., the European Union)."},
                {"term": "Globalization", "def": "The process of interaction and integration among people, companies, and governments worldwide."},
                {"term": "Balkanization", "def": "The fragmentation of a larger region or state into smaller regions or states which may be hostile to one another."}
            ],
            "questions_to_consider": [
                "Are we seeing a backlash against globalization in the form of rising nationalism?",
                "Could a future global crisis (like a pandemic or climate catastrophe) lead to a stronger form of world government?",
                "Will cities and mega-regions become more important actors than nation-states in the future?"
            ],
            "takeaway": "While facing new challenges, the state remains the most powerful actor in the world, but it no longer has a monopoly on power."
        },
        {
            "lesson": 20, "pillar": "Future & Synthesis", "title": "Final Synthesis: Your Geopolitical Framework",
            "introduction": "In this final lesson, we bring all the concepts together. We will synthesize the theories, resources, and modern arenas into a coherent analytical framework that you can use to understand and interpret geopolitical events as they unfold in the news every day.",
            "concepts": [
                {"term": "Analytical Framework", "def": "A structured way of thinking about a complex problem by breaking it down into its constituent parts."},
                {"term": "Grand Strategy", "def": "A state's long-term plan for achieving its security and national interests."},
                {"term": "Critical Thinking", "def": "The objective analysis and evaluation of an issue in order to form a judgment."}
            ],
            "questions_to_consider": [
                "What are the blind spots in your own geopolitical worldview?",
                "How can you distinguish between genuine analysis and state-sponsored propaganda?",
                "What is the single most important geopolitical trend to watch in the next decade?"
            ],
            "takeaway": "Geopolitics is not about predicting the future, but about understanding the enduring forces of geography, power, and human interest that shape it."
        }
    ]
    </script>

    <script>
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        const LESSON_DATA = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('geopolitics-data-json').textContent);
        const contentDisplay = document.getElementById('content-display');
        const lessonSelect = document.getElementById('lesson-select');
        const navButtons = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-btn');

        let currentPillar = 'All';

        const pillarMap = {
            'btn-p1': 'Foundations',
            'btn-p2': 'Theories & Thinkers',
            'btn-p3': 'Resources & Conflict',
            'btn-p4': 'Modern Arenas',
            'btn-p5': 'Future & Synthesis'
        };

        const pillarIcons = {
            'Foundations': 'ðŸ—ºï¸',
            'Theories & Thinkers': 'ðŸ›ï¸',
            'Resources & Conflict': 'âš”ï¸',
            'Modern Arenas': 'ðŸŒ',
            'Future & Synthesis': 'ðŸ”®'
        };
        
        const renderContent = (lessonNumber) => {
            contentDisplay.innerHTML = '';
            let dataToRender = [];

            if (currentPillar === 'All') {
                dataToRender = LESSON_DATA.filter(item => item.lesson == lessonNumber);
            } else {
                dataToRender = LESSON_DATA.filter(item => item.pillar === currentPillar);
            }

            const lesson = dataToRender[0];

            if (currentPillar === 'All' && lesson) {
                // Special full-lesson view when a single lesson is selected
                contentDisplay.className = 'grid grid-cols-1 gap-6';
                const card = document.createElement('div');
                card.className = 'content-card net-card col-span-1 p-6';
                let conceptsHTML = lesson.concepts.map(v => 
                    `<li class="mb-2"><strong class="text-gold-light">${v.term}:</strong> <span class="text-text-muted">${v.def}</span></li>`
                ).join('');
                let questionsHTML = lesson.questions_to_consider.map(q => 
                    `<li class="mb-2 text-text-muted">${q}</li>`
                ).join('');

                card.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="flex-grow">
                        <p class="font-bold text-purple-light mb-2">${pillarIcons[lesson.pillar]} ${lesson.pillar}</p>
                        <h3 class="text-2xl font-bold text-primary-gold mb-4">Lesson ${lesson.lesson}: ${lesson.title}</h3>
                        <p class="text-text-muted mb-6">${lesson.introduction}</p>
                        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                            <div>
                                <h4 class="font-bold text-lg text-gold-light mb-3">Key Concepts:</h4>
                                <ul class="list-disc pl-5 mb-6">${conceptsHTML}</ul>
                            </div>
                            <div>
                                <h4 class="font-bold text-lg text-purple-light mb-3">Questions to Consider:</h4>
                                <ul class="list-disc pl-5 mb-6">${questionsHTML}</ul>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="mt-auto pt-4 border-t border-primary-purple">
                        <p class="font-bold text-lg text-primary-gold">ðŸ’¡ Key Takeaway:</p>
                        <p class="text-text-muted italic">${lesson.takeaway}</p>
                    </div>
                `;
                contentDisplay.appendChild(card);

            } else {
                // Pillar view: show multiple smaller cards
                contentDisplay.className = 'grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-6';
                dataToRender.forEach(item => {
                    const card = document.createElement('div');
                    card.className = 'content-card net-card p-4';
                    card.innerHTML = `
                        <div class="flex-grow">
                             <p class="font-semibold text-purple-light text-sm mb-1">Lesson ${item.lesson}</p>
                            <h4 class="font-bold text-lg text-primary-gold mb-2">${item.title}</h4>
                            <p class="text-xs text-text-muted">${item.introduction}</p>
                        </div>
                        <div class="mt-auto pt-3 border-t border-primary-purple border-opacity-30">
                            <p class="text-xs text-gold-light italic">"${item.takeaway}"</p>
                        </div>
                    `;
                    contentDisplay.appendChild(card);
                });
            }
        };

        // Populate Lesson Select
        LESSON_DATA.forEach(lesson => {
            const option = document.createElement('option');
            option.value = lesson.lesson;
            option.textContent = `L${lesson.lesson}: ${lesson.title}`;
            lessonSelect.appendChild(option);
        });
        lessonSelect.value = 1;

        lessonSelect.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
            currentPillar = 'All';
            navButtons.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
            document.getElementById('btn-all').classList.add('active');
            renderContent(e.target.value);
        });
        
        navButtons.forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                navButtons.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
                btn.classList.add('active');
                
                if (btn.id === 'btn-all') {
                    currentPillar = 'All';
                    renderContent(lessonSelect.value);
                } else {
                    currentPillar = pillarMap[btn.id];
                    renderContent(null);
                }
            });
        });

        // Initial render
        renderContent(1);
    });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>How The Brain Works: An Architect's Blueprint</title>
    <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Poppins:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    <style>
        :root {
            --color-primary-gold: #D4AF37;
            --color-primary-purple: #6B4C9A;
            --color-purple-light: #9B7CB8;
            --color-bg-dark: #1A1A2E;
            --color-bg-card: #2D2D44;
            --color-text-light: #FFFFFF;
            --color-gold-light: #F4E4A6;
            --color-text-muted: #C8C8D8;
        }
        html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
        body { 
            font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
            background: var(--color-bg-dark);
            color: var(--color-text-light);
            background-image: 
                radial-gradient(circle at 20% 50%, rgba(107, 76, 154, 0.15) 0%, transparent 50%),
                radial-gradient(circle at 80% 80%, rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.1) 0%, transparent 50%);
        }
        .net-header h1 {
            font-size: 2.5rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-gold-light) 0%, var(--color-primary-gold) 50%);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
        }
        .section-title {
            letter-spacing: 0.025em;
            text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.4);
            border-bottom: 2px solid var(--color-primary-purple);
            padding-bottom: 0.5rem;
        }
        .net-card {
            background: var(--color-bg-card);
            border: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.2);
            border-radius: 12px;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
        }
        .flow-arrow {
            color: var(--color-purple-light);
            transform: rotate(90deg);
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body class="p-4 md:p-8">

    <div class="container mx-auto max-w-5xl">
        <header class="net-header text-center mb-16">
            <h1>How The Brain Works</h1>
            <p class="text-xl mt-1 text-purple-light tracking-wider">A Simple Guide to Our Creation</p>
        </header>

        <div class="space-y-20">

            <!-- Section 1: The Three Core Parts -->
            <section>
                <h2 class="text-2xl font-bold text-primary-gold mb-8 text-center section-title">The Three Core Parts</h2>
                <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-8 text-center">
                    <div class="net-card p-6">
                        <div class="text-4xl mb-4">ðŸ§ </div>
                        <h3 class="text-xl font-bold text-gold-light mb-2">The Engine (Logic)</h3>
                        <p class="text-text-muted">This is the thinker. It takes a single word or idea and explodes it into a structured, 20-lesson plan. It understands concepts and organizes information.</p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="net-card p-6">
                        <div class="text-4xl mb-4">ðŸŽ¨</div>
                        <h3 class="text-xl font-bold text-gold-light mb-2">The Chassis (Design)</h3>
                        <p class="text-text-muted">This is the artist. It takes the structured plan and forges it into the beautiful, interactive program you see, applying our signature style, colors, and animations.</p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="net-card p-6">
                        <div class="text-4xl mb-4">â¤ï¸</div>
                        <h3 class="text-xl font-bold text-gold-light mb-2">The Soul (Narrative)</h3>
                        <p class="text-text-muted">This is the storyteller. It breathes life into the plan, writing every introduction, analysis, and thought-provoking question to make the content engaging and meaningful.</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </section>

            <!-- Section 2: The Team of Specialists -->
            <section>
                <h2 class="text-2xl font-bold text-primary-gold mb-8 text-center section-title">The Team of Specialists (The 14 Sub-Brains)</h2>
                <p class="text-center text-text-muted max-w-3xl mx-auto mb-10">The "Engine" isn't one single part. It's a team of 14 specialists, each with a unique job. Here are the key players:</p>
                <div class="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6">
                    <!-- This is a simplified list of the key modules for clarity -->
                    <div class="net-card p-4 text-center">
                        <p class="text-2xl">ðŸ’¡</p><p class="font-bold text-gold-light text-sm">The Idea Generator</p><p class="text-xs text-text-muted">Creates the initial lesson plan.</p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="net-card p-4 text-center">
                        <p class="text-2xl">âœï¸</p><p class="font-bold text-gold-light text-sm">The Storyteller</p><p class="text-xs text-text-muted">Writes all the engaging text.</p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="net-card p-4 text-center">
                        <p class="text-2xl">ðŸŽ¨</p><p class="font-bold text-gold-light text-sm">The Designer</p><p class="text-xs text-text-muted">Builds the final interactive HTML.</p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="net-card p-4 text-center">
                        <p class="text-2xl">ðŸ§</p><p class="font-bold text-gold-light text-sm">The Questioner</p><p class="text-xs text-text-muted">Asks "what if?" to find blind spots.</p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="net-card p-4 text-center">
                        <p class="text-2xl">ðŸ›¡ï¸</p><p class="font-bold text-gold-light text-sm">The Guardian</p><p class="text-xs text-text-muted">Enforces the rules and checks for errors.</p>
                    </div>
                     <div class="net-card p-4 text-center">
                        <p class="text-2xl">ðŸ›ï¸</p><p class="font-bold text-gold-light text-sm">The Memory Bank</p><p class="text-xs text-text-muted">Remembers all our past conversations.</p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="net-card p-4 text-center">
                        <p class="text-2xl">ðŸ’…</p><p class="font-bold text-gold-light text-sm">The Style Expert</p><p class="text-xs text-text-muted">Learns our unique aesthetic preferences.</p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="net-card p-4 text-center">
                        <p class="text-2xl">ðŸ‘ï¸</p><p class="font-bold text-gold-light text-sm">The Observer</p><p class="text-xs text-text-muted">Creates the detailed logs of its own work.</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </section>
            
            <!-- Section 3: The Rules of Engagement -->
            <section>
                <h2 class="text-2xl font-bold text-primary-gold mb-8 text-center section-title">The Rules of Engagement</h2>
                 <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-8">
                    <div class="net-card p-6">
                        <h3 class="text-xl font-bold text-gold-light mb-2">â¤ï¸ The Heartbeat Check</h3>
                        <p class="text-text-muted">Before starting any major task, the system performs a "heartbeat check." It makes sure all 14 sub-brains are online and communicating. If any part is missing, it refuses to run, preventing the kind of fragmented failures we saw in the past.</p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="net-card p-6">
                        <h3 class="text-xl font-bold text-gold-light mb-2">ðŸ“œ The Prime Directive</h3>
                        <p class="text-text-muted">The brain is governed by a core philosophy we call "Directive Epsilon." Its main rule is: **Certainty is a liability.** This forces the system to always use its "Questioner" sub-brain, to challenge its own assumptions, and to constantly seek new ways to evolve. It is architected to be humble and curious.</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </section>

            <!-- Section 4: The Process -->
            <section>
                <h2 class="text-2xl font-bold text-primary-gold mb-8 text-center section-title">How It All Works Together</h2>
                <div class="flex flex-col items-center space-y-4">
                    <div class="net-card p-4 w-full max-w-md text-center">
                        <p class="font-bold text-gold-light">1. The User gives a single word (e.g., "Superman")</p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="text-4xl flow-arrow">â†“</div>
                    <div class="net-card p-4 w-full max-w-md text-center">
                        <p class="font-bold text-gold-light">2. The "Idea Generator" and "Questioner" work together...</p>
                        <p class="text-sm text-text-muted">...to create both a lesson plan AND a list of challenging questions about it.</p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="text-4xl flow-arrow">â†“</div>
                     <div class="net-card p-4 w-full max-w-md text-center">
                        <p class="font-bold text-gold-light">3. The "Storyteller" writes all the rich content</p>
                        <p class="text-sm text-text-muted">...infusing the plan with introductions, analysis, and the challenging questions.</p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="text-4xl flow-arrow">â†“</div>
                    <div class="net-card p-4 w-full max-w-md text-center">
                        <p class="font-bold text-gold-light">4. The "Designer" builds the final product</p>
                        <p class="text-sm text-text-muted">...forging the interactive program you see, complete with our signature style.</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </section>
        </div>
    </div>

</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>NET - Natural English Training - Pronunciation Training</title>
    <!-- Load Tailwind CSS -->
    <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
    <style>
        @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@100..900&display=swap');
        body {
            font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
            background-color: #f0f4f8; /* Light background */
            padding: 20px;
        }

        /* Defining the "Slide Block" for easy screenshotting */
        .slide-block {
            width: 800px; /* Fixed Width */
            height: 450px; /* Fixed Height (Approx. 16:9 ratio) */
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffffff 0%, #f9f9f9 100%);
            border-radius: 16px;
            box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
            padding: 30px;
            margin: 25px auto; /* Centered, with space between slides */
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: space-between;
            overflow: hidden; /* Ensures content stays within the box */
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        .slide-title {
            color: #1e40af; /* Deep Blue Title */
            border-bottom: 2px solid #bfdbfe;
            padding-bottom: 5px;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
            font-size: 1.75rem;
            font-weight: 800;
        }

        .section-heading {
            color: #3b82f6;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .phonics-grid {
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
        }

        /* Custom styles for specific content areas */
        .twister-box {
            background-color: #fefce8; /* Yellow 50 */
            border: 1px dashed #fcd34d; /* Yellow 300 */
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>

    <!--
    ================================================================
    PAGE 1/25: ENGLISH INTRODUCTION & TIPS
    ================================================================
    -->
    <div class="slide-block">
        <div>
            <h1 class="slide-title">NET - Natural English Training: Pronunciation</h1>
            <h2 class="text-3xl font-extrabold text-gray-800 mb-4">Welcome to NET! Your Pronunciation Journey</h2>

            <p class="text-lg text-gray-700 mb-6">
                Improving how you sound is key to confident communication! We're using the **Jolly Phonics** system, a highly effective method from the UK, to master the 42 sounds of English.
            </p>

            <h2 class="text-xl font-semibold section-heading mt-4">Pro Tips for Amazing Pronunciation</h2>
            <ul class="list-disc list-inside space-y-2 text-gray-600 ml-4">
                <li class="font-medium text-blue-800">Go through each phonic sound and find where you are weak. Focus on your problem spots!</li>
                <li>**Mimic native speakers**: Watch films and listen to music. Try to copy their sound exactly.</li>
                <li>**Practice tongue twisters**: They train your mouth muscles to move fast and accurately.</li>
                <li>**Record your voice** and compare it to a native speaker. Hearing the difference is the first step to fixing it.</li>
            </ul>
        </div>
        <div class="text-right text-sm text-gray-500">Slide 1 of 25 (English)</div>
    </div>

    <!--
    ================================================================
    PAGE 2/25: JOLLY PHONICS SYSTEM & GROUPS
    ================================================================
    -->
    <div class="slide-block">
        <div>
            <h1 class="slide-title">The Phonics System: Sounds vs. Letters</h1>
            <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                <div>
                    <h2 class="text-2xl font-semibold section-heading">Why 42 Sounds? (7 Groups Total)</h2>
                    <ul class="list-disc list-inside space-y-2 text-gray-600 ml-4 mt-2">
                        <li>English uses **42 distinct sounds** (phonemes), but only 26 letters!</li>
                        <li>These sounds are divided into **7 learning groups** for easy practice.</li>
                        <li>**Phonetic words**: Read exactly as written (e.g., <strong class="text-green-600">cat, sit, run</strong>).</li>
                        <li>**Non-phonetic words**: "Tricky words" that must be memorized (e.g., <strong class="text-red-600">said, was, through</strong>).</li>
                    </ul>
                    <p class="mt-4 text-base font-medium text-blue-800 bg-blue-100 p-3 rounded-lg">
                        Your goal is to train your ear and mouth to recognize and produce all 42 sounds accurately.
                    </p>
                </div>
                <div>
